source.query: SELECT n.original_ext_source_id AS hip, g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.ruwe, g.ref_epoch, h.ra AS hip_ra, h.dec AS hip_dec, h.plx AS hip_plx, h.e_plx AS hip_plx_error, h.pm_ra AS hip_pmra, h.pm_de AS hip_pmdec, h.sn AS hip_solution, h.nc AS hip_components FROM gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS n JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g ON g.source_id = n.source_id JOIN public.hipparcos_newreduction AS h ON h.hip = n.original_ext_source_id WHERE n.original_ext_source_id IN ({ids})
source.stated_query: SELECT {hip} AS hip, g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.ruwe, g.ref_epoch, h.ra AS hip_ra, h.dec AS hip_dec, h.plx AS hip_plx, h.e_plx AS hip_plx_error, h.pm_ra AS hip_pmra, h.pm_de AS hip_pmdec, h.sn AS hip_solution, h.nc AS hip_components FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g, public.hipparcos_newreduction AS h WHERE g.source_id = {source_id} AND h.hip = {hip}

purpose: Reviewed Hipparcos/Gaia DR3 inputs for the 2026-10-30 refresh of del Ind and sig02 UMa (scripts/data_ingestion/augment_star_registry_astrometry.py fetch-hg / apply-hg). Both are binaries whose catalog proper motions are snapshots of an orbit: ORB6 FIN 307 (del Ind, P = 12.16 yr, grade 1) and STF1306AB (sig02 UMa, P = 921 yr, grade 4).
